title: Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39-byte hex body vs the 40 both pinned tools and Datadog's own validators corroborate (trufflehog datadogtoken; gitleaks datadog-access-token; datadog-agent keys.go [a-f0-9]{40}). Twin of "Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
